# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_BAND_BREAKOUT_WITH_RIBBON_CONFIRM

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Early break of the opening range with a VWAP extension and aligned EMA ribbon signals strong intraday momentum. The combination captures immediate buying pressure after the initial range is violated, while VWAP extension and ribbon alignment filter for sustained trend strength rather than random noise.

## Mechanism

Entry: On the same 5‑minute bar, require (1) price > opening range high, (2) price > VWAP + 0.5×ATR(14), and (3) 8/21/34/55 EMA ribbon bullish (8>21>34>55). Enter long at the bar’s close. Exit: Initial stop at the opening range low (chart‑stop). Take profit at 2× risk (R‑multiple). Runner trails 15% off the highest‑high‑since‑entry using a chandelier exit. Regime filter: Only consider trades when VIX < 18 and time between 09:45‑11:30; skip if the EMA ribbon is flat or intertwined (|8‑21| < 0.05×ATR(14) etc.).
